reviews.text: Excellent grooming for a very matted dog thanks so much

Appreciate your kind feedback.    🙏

Many thanks.  😍 …

Been coming here for years with my two Maine Coons. Wonderful family business with a true love for animals. Both my cats treated with love and care and always taking into account any particular requirements and requests. Cats have always been calm and happy with them.
My chow chow was groomed perfectly and smells like candy !!!
Really nice family run local pet shop. Also very friendly and helpful, we recommend their grooming service

We have been to Tip Toe Grooming a few times now for our dog’s groom and wash and have always had such a lovely experience. Everyone is so friendly, welcoming and always happy to help. She comes out looking great and smelling so fresh every time! Would definitely recommend 😊

They have always been great with our dog, who is very nervous at the groomer, and she looks perfect when she comes out. They are very flexible and willing to accommodate last minute appointments which is very helpful.

Absolutely wonderful! I recommend the time with my eyes closed. I have a Pomeranian that is very has difficult to grooming, especially when it comes to washing and trimming.

I’ve been with them for about two years now, and from the very beginning they have always been incredibly supportive, helpful, patient, and caring. Whenever I need anything, they’re always there to help and make sure my dog is well taken care of.

I trust them completely and recommend them to all my friends and clients without hesitation. They are truly amazing at what they do! ❤️
Amazing groomers. Very knowledgeable and very good at achieving the desired outcome.

I used to have a Ukrainian groomer here who was really good and always finished on time. Since she left, I’ve had my dogs groomed by the older lady instead. The waiting time is always very long, and unfortunately, the quality of her grooming is nowhere near as good. I’ve been very disappointed with the service.
